FACT-2.gloss: She placed 220 post-it notes on the cups of coffee

FACT-3.gloss: Candice had 23 post-it notes remaining after placing them on the cups of coffee

RULE-1.gloss: If x started with a post-it notes, placed b post-it notes at work, had c post-it notes remaining, and a + b + c = p, then x purchased a package of p post-it notes
RULE-1.verify_reason: The correct relationship is a + p = b + c (starting notes plus purchased package equals notes used plus notes remaining), so p = b + c − a. The rule incorrectly adds a, b, and c together to get p, which double-counts the starting notes instead of subtracting them.

INF-1.gloss: Candice purchased a package of 323 post-it notes, from FACT-1, FACT-2, FACT-3, OP-2, and RULE-1 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens
